## Description

Provide a brief summary of the changes introduced by this pull request.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Security fix

## Verification & Testing

- [ ] All unit tests pass (`go test ./...`)
- [ ] Race detector verified (`go test -race ./...`)
- [ ] Static analysis clean (`go vet ./...`)
- [ ] Code formatted with `gofmt -w .`

## Security Checklist

- [ ] Untrusted inputs wrapped in security envelopes where applicable
- [ ] Path traversal checks verified
- [ ] Secrets redacted from logs and messages

## Checklist

- [ ] Followed Conventional Commit guidelines
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Updated `docs/feature-matrix.md`
- [ ] Updated `README.md` if user-facing interface changed
